question: What is Diginex

beat.line: Four separate businesses have now been absorbed into it.
beat.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beat.action: The previous chip flips away as the document pile splits into four paper folders; tape pieces bind them into one block.

sources: Following acquisitions of Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, and the transformative addition of Resulticks, Diginex is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform spanning carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency, human rights due diligence, and now AI-driven customer data capabilities — designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.
Diginex has now absorbed four distinct businesses (Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, Resulticks) across multiple jurisdictions — a complex undertaking.
warnings: headline number "4" not found as a figure in cited sentences [3,25] (fine if it is a count of items those sentences enumerate; flagged either way)
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: four paper folders; tape pieces.
Opens on the document pile, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips away as the document pile splits into four paper folders; tape pieces bind them into one block.
Ends holding on the taped block.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "4 BUSINESSES".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "4 BUSINESSES". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Four separate businesses have now been absorbed into it.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage with a refined 2D motion design, photographed as a flat lay under soft room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, which features a purple paper ground, a black paper chip with the text "ESG DATA", and a pile of rough, torn white paper documents. Immediately upon the first frame, the black "ESG DATA" chip flips upward and away with fast motion and a slight overshoot, disappearing from the frame. Simultaneously, the purple ground is instantly covered by a new, single unbroken block of pale cyan paper. The pile of white documents in the lower two-thirds of the frame splits apart into four distinct black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of paper folders. Each folder is plain and unmarked, with rough white torn-paper edges and a small soft shadow cast toward the bottom right from a consistent light source in the upper left. As the folders separate, several small strips of matte cream-colored paper tape quickly slide in from the edges of the frame, binding the four folders together into one solid, aligned block. Simultaneously, a new cream-colored paper chip descends rapidly from the top into the upper third of the frame, landing with a slight bounce. Printed on this chip in an extra-bold black sans-serif typeface is the text "4 BUSINESSES", which remains clean, legible, and stable. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout. The final two seconds hold on this composition of the taped folder block and the headline chip against the pale cyan ground, with a very subtle, slow pulsing shift in the positions of the elements to create a continuous loop. Throughout the shot, a narrator (S1), a man with a warm, clear, natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says: <d>[English] Four separate businesses have now been absorbed into it.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio features the crisp, tactile sounds of paper interaction, including a quick flicking sound as the first chip flips away, four distinct soft paper-slaps as the folders split and land, and the sticky, adhesive "tack" of tape pieces snapping into place.
